core_questions.question: Where is the pain located (e.g. lower right, upper center), and is it sharp, cramping, or constant severe pain?
core_questions.safety_implication: Lower right quadrant sharp pain or rigid abdomen suggests acute appendicitis/peritoneal irritation.

core_questions.question: Have you noticed any vomiting blood, black tarry stools, yellowing of skin/eyes, or dizziness when standing?
core_questions.safety_implication: GI bleeding signs (hematemesis or melena) are medical emergencies.

core_questions.question: If applicable, is there any possibility of pregnancy?
core_questions.safety_implication: Abdominal pain with possible pregnancy requires ruling out ectopic pregnancy.

warning_signs.label: Acute Rigid Abdomen or Severe 9-10 Pain

counterfactuals.condition: If pain is accompanied by black tarry stools, vomiting blood, or fainting
If severe pain focalizes to lower right abdomen with fever
counterfactuals.recommendation_shift: Urgent Care / Emergency Evaluation needed for appendicitis

counterfactuals.condition: If mild stomach upset following a known meal with no fever or dehydration
